ana-ml: quick heads-up — shadow run for orion-13b with INT8 KV shows a consistent accuracy delta on long-context evals (~1024+ tokens). saw ~0.9% EM drop vs FP16-KV baseline across our long-QA suite. logs attached to the run in the dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/runs/3105551234 :worried:

matt-perf: can you paste the microbench numbers? p50/p95 token latency and mem usage?

ana-ml: sure. trimmed version: 
- FP16-KV: p50 28ms, p95 72ms, KV memory (resident) 11.8GB
- INT8-KV: p50 25ms, p95 83ms, KV memory 7.2GB
so latency median improved, but p95 widened and accuracy dropped only on prompts that exercise deep KV reads (long multi-turn).

leah-eng: interesting — does the drop correlate with eviction events or hash collisions?

ana-ml: looked at telemetry. eviction rate didn't spike. however interleaved reads where the model hits many sparse KV segments shows slightly noisier logits in the recomposed outputs. the per-token logit L2 diff distribution has a heavy tail.

sam-runtime: heavy tail could be dequantization rounding during KV read + attention accumulation. did you try hybrid: FP16 for keys for last N layers, INT8 for rest?

ana-ml: i ran a quick hybrid: keys FP16 for top 4 layers, INT8 elsewhere. accuracy delta shrank to ~0.2% and p95 latency went to 77ms, mem 8.9GB. so it's promising.

matt-perf: can you share the exact config you used to reproduce? put in a one-liner run command so infra can spin it.

ana-ml: pasted below (use test harness on the runbot):

```
REDWOOD_MODEL=orion-13b \nREDWOOD_QUANT_KV=INT8 \nREDWOOD_HYBRID_KV=top4_fp16 \nREDWOOD_RUN_TAG=kv-stash-int8-hybrid-check
python perf/run_shadow.py --suite long_qa --outdir /tmp/shadow-3105551234
```

leah-eng: nice. two quick probes: 1) try INT8 with stochastic rounding disabled (we had a bug in the FP8 path where SR changed across kernels). 2) run a deterministic single-instance reproducer with the same RNG seed and dump attention weights for a mispredicted example.

ana-ml: will do. already queued a deterministic run with seed=42 and SR=off. ci-bot: kicked shadow job 3105551240.

ci-bot: job 3105551240 queued -> running on dedicated shadow pool (gpus: a100-40g). logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/3105551240

sam-runtime: also log KV read buffer alignment and byte offsets. if we have unaligned loads the older xform kernels fall back to slower paths and possible rounding differences. can we add a quick perf counter in runtime for "kv_unaligned_reads"?

zoe-sre: FYI — if p95 increases we might impact SLOs for hosted customers if this quant is shipped. recommend gating on p95 < 80ms and accuracy delta < 0.5% for long-qa.

matt-perf: agreed on gates. also should publish a shadow summary doc in the repo: short table with model, quant-KV variant, mem reduction, p50/p95, accuracy delta. ana, can you drop the snapshot here when ready?

ana-ml: yup. attaching initial snapshot summary (trimmed):

- baseline FP16-KV: mem 11.8GB, p50 28ms, p95 72ms, EM delta 0.0%
- INT8-KV (all layers): mem 7.2GB, p50 25ms, p95 83ms, EM delta -0.9%
- INT8-KV + top4 FP16 keys: mem 8.9GB, p50 26ms, p95 77ms, EM delta -0.2%
- FP8-KV (experimental AWQ): mem 6.5GB, p50 24ms, p95 90ms, EM delta -1.4%

notes: FP8 (AWQ) gave biggest mem wins but introduced worst tail and largest accuracy regression on long contexts.

leah-eng: thanks. next steps i propose:
1) reproduce deterministic failing examples and collect attention+logit diffs.
2) try layerwise per-key dtype (auto-search for first layer where switching to FP16 recovers >0.4% EM) — could be 1-5 layers not necessarily top4.
3) add runtime telemetry counters: kv_unaligned_reads, kv_read_fallbacks, dequant_error_rms per-layer (sampled).

sam-runtime: i can add the counters; i'll ship a small runtime canary tomorrow. then we can re-run shadow with telemetry on.

zoe-sre: add an alert rule for shadow runs where p95 delta > 8ms vs baseline so we don't miss regressions in future automated jobs.

matt-perf: also add an econometrics note: if mem reduction <30% the cost saving may not justify a 0.2% accuracy hit for some customers. include cost estimates in the shadow doc.

ana-ml: will create the shadow doc at repos/eng-ml/kv-quant-shadow/3105551234.md and drop a light TL;DR after the deterministic reproducer completes. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sam-runtime: ping me when the canary is up, i'll run the telemetry-enabled shadow.

ci-bot: job 3105551240 completed (status: success). artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/artifacts/3105551240/summary.json

ana-ml: got it — saving artifacts and starting the deterministic dump now. expected finish ~10m.

zoe-sre: keeping an eye on the p95 dashboard.

matt-perf: good discussion. we should make sure this flow becomes a standard checklist for any KV quant change.
